title: Recovery: Core Loop
summary: Mark the loss, gear lightly, retrieve carefully, and make the next death less likely.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Identify the grave, choose the safest route, carry a minimal recovery kit, retrieve inventory, and leave before converting recovery into another loss.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each retrieval, ask why the death happened: route, gear, timing, hazard, or panic. Fix the cause before chasing the next objective.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop once the grave is safe or the route is clearly not ready. A second prepared attempt beats feeding more gear into the same mistake.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
